title: Guided migrations
subtitle: One resumable run per source team and target server: preflight, import, data, certificates, verification and cutover, with a gate and an approval at every step that needs one.

list.activeOnly: Only runs that are still live
list.empty: Connect a Coolify or Dokploy source in Import, review the plan, then choose Run guided migration. Start with a dry run: it writes nothing outside the run's own records.
list.hint: A run is driven by the hub but needs you at the gates: the source-host command, the freeze, the verification approval and the point of no return.
list.campaignFilter: Show only the runs of campaign {campaign}
list.campaignRollup: {total} runs: {completed} completed, {live} live, {failed} failed, {other} dry-run or stopped
list.campaignRollupCapped: At least {total} runs: {completed} completed, {live} live, {failed} failed, {other} dry-run or stopped

rollback.UNDOABLE: Fully undoable before the point of no return
rollback.LOSSY_AFTER_PONR: After this, only a lossy reverse exists

mode.copyHint: The source keeps running as a second system. Nothing on it is removed.
mode.takeoverHint: Tugra replaces the source. After finalizing, the source can be stopped (never deleted) in a separate, typed step.

topology.two-boxHint: Tugra runs on its own server. Traffic moves by changing DNS.
topology.swap-proxyHint: Tugra runs beside the source on the same host. Traffic moves by swapping which proxy owns ports 80 and 443; DNS is not touched.

hint.migrator-reported: The migrator on the source host reported this. The hub could not check it independently.
hint.operator-attested: You confirmed this by hand. Nothing checked it.
hint.source-api-reported: The source's own API said so (read-only token). The hub could not check it independently.
hint.host-loop-reported: A read-only probe of the host script reported this and you carried it back. The hub could not check it independently.

PREFLIGHT.title: Preflight
PREFLIGHT.desc: Checks the plan, the target server, certificates, DNS access and disk. Reads only.

IMPORT.title: Import configuration
IMPORT.desc: Creates the apps, databases and services on the target from the reviewed plan. Undoable.

DNS_PREPARE.title: Prepare DNS
DNS_PREPARE.desc: Lowers record TTLs now so the later change takes effect quickly. Waits for the old TTL to expire.

DATA_SEED.title: Rehearse data copy
DATA_SEED.desc: A non-disruptive first pass: inventory, speed test, object seed. Optional.

FREEZE.title: Freeze the source
FREEZE.desc: Opens the downtime window by stopping the source writers. The source stays stopped after a complete copy.

DATA_FINAL.title: Final data copy
DATA_FINAL.desc: The last, complete copy of volumes, databases and objects, then verification.

REMAP_ENV.title: Re-point environment
REMAP_ENV.desc: Rewrites references to source databases so apps use the Tugra ones.

DEPLOY_DARK.title: Deploy dark
DEPLOY_DARK.desc: Starts the databases and apps on the target without public traffic.

TLS_PREISSUE.title: Issue certificates
TLS_PREISSUE.desc: Prepares valid certificates before traffic moves.

VERIFY.title: Verify and approve
VERIFY.desc: Parity and runtime checks, then your typed approval of exactly what was verified.

CUTOVER.title: Cutover
CUTOVER.desc: Moves production traffic to Tugra. This is the point of no return for stateful hosts.

OBSERVE.title: Observe
OBSERVE.desc: Watches the moved hosts for a while before finishing.

FINALIZE.title: Finalize
FINALIZE.desc: Restores the original TTLs, writes the report and revokes temporary access.

DECOMMISSION.title: Decommission source
DECOMMISSION.desc: Takeover only, never automatic: stops the source containers and prints removal commands. Tugra deletes nothing.

next.title: What I am waiting for
next.timerDue: The wait is over; the hub continues on its next tick.
next.failedHint: A failed step is not final. Retry it once the cause is fixed, or abort the run to put the source back in charge.

actions.startBody: The hub begins with preflight and imports the configuration onto the target. Nothing touches production traffic until the verification approval.
actions.promoteBody: A new real run is created from the same reviewed inputs. The plan is checked again and the source must still match.
actions.pauseBody: Forward progress stops. Nothing is undone and nothing is rolled back.

banner.dryRunBody: It projects what each step would do and writes nothing outside the run's own records.
banner.dryRunBlocked: {blocks} item(s) would stop a real run and {unknown} could not be checked.
banner.dryRunClean: Nothing would stop a real run ({warns} warning(s)).
banner.ponrBefore: Before the point of no return you can abort: the source becomes authoritative again and nothing is deleted.
banner.ponrPastBody: Abort is no longer possible. You can finish the run, or reverse it; a reverse can lose data written to Tugra after the cutover.

ponr.title: Point of no return
ponr.body: Approving lets the hub route production traffic of stateful apps to Tugra. From then on the source no longer receives their writes and abort is refused. Only a reverse remains, and it can lose data Tugra wrote after the switch.

approval.dataRisk: I understand stateful data may be lost if this is reversed after traffic has moved.
approval.expires: This approval is valid for {minutes} minutes. After that it must be given again.
approval.approvePonr: Approve and pass the point of no return

issue.stale: What you reviewed has changed since you opened this form. Review the new state before approving; the approval is bound to what you saw.
issue.nameMismatch: Type the names exactly as shown.
issue.nameUnavailable: A name needed for confirmation is not known to the hub, so this cannot be confirmed here.

confirm.none: No name is needed to confirm.
confirm.runId: Type the run id to confirm.
confirm.targetServer: Type the target server name to confirm.
confirm.targetServerAndHost: Type the target server name, then the source host, to confirm.
confirm.sourceHost: Type the source host to confirm.
confirm.targetServers: This run places resources on several servers. Type the name of every target server to confirm.
confirm.targetServersAndHost: This run places resources on several servers. Type the name of every target server, then the source host, to confirm.

command.intro: This step runs on the source host. The hub mints a short-lived migration token and shows the command once.
command.shownOnce: Shown once: copy it now. It carries a live token.
command.unfreezeIntro: This script starts the stopped source containers again on the Coolify host. It carries no migration token, so you can get it again whenever you need it.
command.hostLoopIntro: This step runs from the Coolify host. The hub prints one script that loops over the source hosts with the SSH keys Coolify already holds, starts the migrator on each and reports back. The migration token inside is shown once.
command.inventoryIntro: Run this read-only inventory on the Coolify host first. It lists the containers and volumes of each source host so the hub can compare them with what the source API reports.
command.inventory: Run the inventory on the Coolify host

attest.title: Confirm this was done?
attest.body: You are confirming by hand: {what}. The run records it as attested by you, not as verified by the hub.
attest.noteRequired: The plan item this container is (required)

attach.hint: Object storage copies keep their credentials in Migrate objects. Create one there, then attach its id; the run only drives and observes it.
attach.label: Object migration id

skip.title: Skip this step?
skip.body: The step is optional. Skipping it leaves its checks unrun.

session.body: The source session expired. Enter the source API token again to continue. It is stored encrypted by the hub and never shown again.
session.hint: Sent to the hub only; the page does not keep it.
session.active: A fresh source session is ready (valid until {when}).

inputs.title: Owner inputs
inputs.desc: Answers the run may need. An unanswered input blocks only the step that needs it.
inputs.acmeEmailHint: Required for certificates and the cutover. Earlier steps run without it.
inputs.allowBindHint: Off by default: apps with bind mounts are refused rather than copied from an unknown path.
inputs.allowLiveShapeProbe: Allow a read-only live probe of the source API
inputs.allowLiveShapeProbeHint: Lets the hub read the source API to learn its shapes. Off by default.
inputs.sourceControllerHint: Manual prints the steps and records your attestation. API or agent let the hub stop and restart the recorded source containers.
inputs.policiesDesc: Questions the fleet raises. Each unanswered one keeps its safe default, which holds work back rather than moving it.
inputs.minioPolicy: Hosts that use the source's object storage
inputs.minioPolicyHint: Hosts whose environment points at object storage (MinIO). Hold keeps them on the source. Wait for a verified copy flips them after their objects are copied and verified. External means the storage is not on the source host.
inputs.workerPolicyHint: Apps that serve no domain are treated as workers. They are held stopped until after the cutover unless you choose otherwise.
inputs.unlistedDbPolicy: Database containers the source API does not list
inputs.unlistedDbPolicyHint: The host inventory can find database containers the source API never reported. Stopping the run is the safe default.
inputs.orphanVolumePolicyHint: The host inventory can find volumes mounted by nothing. Stopping the run is the safe default.

minioPolicy.external: The storage is external, nothing to copy

workerPolicy.hold-dark: Keep stopped until after the cutover (default)

facts.title: Run
facts.baselineNone: Not recorded yet. The preflight records it before anything changes, so the watch after the cutover can tell what was already failing.

window.note: There is a window: the source is frozen until the first moved host is verified. The estimate comes from measured sizes and speeds and is replaced by the measured number.

recovery.title: Abort and recovery
recovery.desc: Each action says what it does. Nothing here deletes source data.
recovery.abortBody: Before the point of no return: puts the source back in charge. Cancels transfers, revokes tokens, restarts the recorded source containers (or lists them for you), restores TTLs and stops the Tugra copies. Deletes no data.
recovery.abortConfirm: The source becomes authoritative again and the Tugra copies are left stopped. No data is deleted.
recovery.abortRefused: The point of no return has been reached, so abort is refused. Reverse is the only way back.
recovery.cleanupBody: After an abort: removes the resources the run created on Tugra. Resources holding data need an explicit opt-in and their names.
recovery.cleanupConfirm: Removes the Tugra-side resources this run created. The source is not touched.
recovery.includeData: Also remove resources that hold data
recovery.dataNames: Type the name of each data-holding resource to remove, one per line
recovery.reverseBody: After the point of no return: restores DNS from the ledger, or swaps the proxy back. Data Tugra wrote after the switch is not carried back; dump it to the source yourself.
recovery.reverseConfirm: Traffic goes back to the source. Writes Tugra accepted since the cutover can be lost. Nothing syncs backwards.
recovery.ackLoss: I understand data written to Tugra after the cutover can be lost.
recovery.decommissionBody: Takeover only. Stops the source containers and prints removal commands. Tugra deletes nothing on the source.
recovery.decommissionConfirm: The source containers are stopped, not removed. Removal commands are printed for you to run.

events.title: Events
events.error: The event log could not be refreshed. Retrying.

report.title: Report
report.notYet: The report appears when the run has finished or failed.

drawer.bypass: Read-only view of the operation's own panel. Changes are made through the run's steps and approvals, so its gates cannot be bypassed from here.

launch.title: Run guided migration
launch.desc: Let the hub drive the whole migration with gates and approvals, using this reviewed plan. The manual apply above stays available.
launch.dialogDesc: The run freezes this reviewed plan and the choices made above. Start with a dry run to see what would happen; it writes nothing outside the run's own records.
launch.targetHint: The run puts the imported resources on this server. One live run per target server.
launch.dryRunHint: Projects every step and ends without changing anything. You can promote it to a real run afterwards.
launch.acmeHint: Optional now. Certificates and the cutover are blocked until it is set.
launch.observeHint: How long to watch moved hosts before finishing. 0 to skip.
launch.observeInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4320.

placement.title: Where each source host lands
placement.toggle: Place source hosts on different Tugra servers
placement.hint: Off: every resource lands on the target server above. On: each source host is mapped to a Tugra server, and a host that is missing from the map stops the run instead of landing on the default server.
placement.none: The plan names no source host, so there is nothing to place.
placement.invalid: Every source host needs a Tugra server, and at most {max} hosts can be mapped.
placement.teamOnly: Only servers of the target server's team are offered.

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.desc: Defaults are safe. Open this for a fleet with several source hosts, large databases or a small build host.
advanced.campaignHint: An optional label that groups the runs of one migration campaign, so you can list them together.
advanced.runner: Who runs the migrator on the source hosts
advanced.runnerHint: The host-loop script is printed once and run on the Coolify host. It uses the SSH keys Coolify already holds, loops over the source hosts and reports back.

runnerChoice.agent: The Tugra agent on the source host
runnerChoice.coolify-host-loop: One script on the Coolify host, looping over the hosts

hostLoop.keyDir: SSH key directory on the Coolify host
hostLoop.keyDirHint: Only this path is stored, never a key.
hostLoop.invalid: Use an absolute path of letters, digits and . _ / - without .., 1 to 8 hosts at a time, 5 to 120 seconds and 0 to 5 retries.

advanced.deployWaves: When apps are built and started

deployWavesChoice.single: Everything after the data is copied
deployWavesChoice.earlyStateless: Stateless apps right after the import
deployWavesChoice.earlyBuild: Build every image before the freeze, start after

advanced.deployWavesHint: Building before the freeze keeps the downtime window for starting things. Workers stay stopped either way.
advanced.deployConcurrency: Builds at a time per server
advanced.deployConcurrencyHint: Leave empty for one at a time. Raise it only on servers with spare CPU and memory.
advanced.deployConcurrencyInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8.
advanced.serviceStart: Which services are started before the apps

serviceStartChoice.dependencies: The services a dark app depends on, and the services that have their own domains (default)
serviceStartChoice.none: None, I start them by hand
serviceStartChoice.all: Every imported service except held tunnel connectors

advanced.serviceStartHint: Search engines and document converters start before the apps that call them, so the apps can answer their health check. An object store starts when a dark app depends on it; its buckets always move through an object migration, never through a volume copy.
advanced.largeDbMode: Databases too large for a dump artifact
advanced.largeDbModeHint: Stream a logical dump has no size cap but runs inside the freeze window, so it adds to the downtime.
advanced.stopSource: Let the migrator stop the source writers itself
advanced.stopSourceHint: Off by default. Without it the freeze step asks you to stop the writers.

errors.server-has-live-run: One of the target servers already has a live guided migration. Finish or abort it first.

codes.release_webhooks-repoint: {count} apps now deploy on a git push here. Remove the push webhook at the source (its GitHub App or repository webhook) so a push does not deploy twice. For apps without a connected git source, point the repository webhook at the app's Tugra webhook URL.
codes.observe_workers-not-running: {count} workers did not come up after the cutover: {workers}. Start them from their app pages, then retry the step.
codes.finalize_workers-not-running: {count} workers did not come up after the cutover: {workers}. Start them from their app pages, then retry the step.
codes.tls-preissue_worker-not-redeployed: {count} workers with a hostname were not redeployed here. They stay stopped until after the cutover, so their hostnames cannot be checked yet.
codes.preflight_job-runner-has-domain: {count} apps are marked as job runners but serve a domain, and a hostname has to be checked while the app runs next to the source. Remove the job-runner mark or take the domain off the app: {items}.
codes.preflight_worker-mark-unmatched: {count} worker marks name no app of the plan, so they do nothing and the app they were meant for would start next to the source: {items}. Fix the item or remove the mark.
codes.deploy-dark_worker-mark-unmatched: {count} worker marks name no app of the plan, so they would be ignored: {items}. Fix the item or remove the mark before anything is deployed.
codes.deploy-dark_job-runner-has-domain: {count} apps are marked as job runners but serve a domain, so they cannot be held back. Remove the job-runner mark: {items}.
codes.import_images-pinned: {count} apps were pointed at the image digest the source runs instead of a floating tag.
codes.import_image-pin_failed: Pointing an imported app at the image digest of the source failed.
codes.import_images-pin-pending: {count} image apps still run a floating tag instead of the digest the source runs.
codes.data-seed_host-loop-run: Run the host-loop script on the Coolify host for the {phase} phase. It starts the migrator on {hosts} source hosts over their own SSH keys. {pending} items are still waiting for it.
codes.data-seed_host-loop-host-failed: {failing} of {hosts} source hosts did not finish the {phase} phase: {names}. Run the host-loop script again: a host that failed or finished partial is started again (the migrator skips what is already done), a host that is still running is only re-attached. Add TUGRA_LOOP_RELAUNCH=1 to start a host that finished clean again too.
codes.data-seed_host-inventory-run: Run the host inventory on the Coolify host first. It lists the containers, volumes and bind sizes of {hosts} source hosts and checks that each can reach this hub. {missing} hosts are still missing.
codes.data-seed_dry_host-loop: The migrator will be started on {hosts} source hosts from the Coolify host (key directory {keyDir}, {parallel} at a time).
codes.data-seed_source-running: {count} source containers are running: {names}. They are copied only when stopped, so enable stop-source or stop their writers at the freeze.
codes.data-seed_host-loop-stop-migrators: The run was aborted, but {count} source hosts may still be running a migrator: {hosts}. Stop the containers named tugra-migrator-* there. The migration token is revoked, so they fail on their own at the next hub call.
codes.data_host-loop-no-hosts: The plan names no source host, so the host-loop runner has nothing to loop over. Map the source servers or use another source runner.
codes.host-loop_host-failed: Host {host} did not run the migrator: {state} ({code}). Fix it and run the host-loop script again.
codes.freeze_host-loop-run: Run the host-loop script on the Coolify host to stop the writers on {hosts} source hosts ({items} items). {pending} hosts have not reported a stop yet.
codes.freeze_host-loop-host-failed: Host {host} could not stop its writers ({state}: {code}).
codes.freeze_host-loop-no-host: {count} stop-list items have no known source host, so no host can be told to stop them: {names}.
codes.freeze_host-loop-unfreeze: The freeze was undone, but {count} source hosts may still have writers stopped by this run: {hosts}. Get the unfreeze script below and run it on the Coolify host: it starts exactly the containers this run recorded and stopped there, and reports what it did.
codes.freeze_dry_host-loop: The writers are stopped on {hosts} source hosts through the host-loop script ({items} items).
codes.inventory_not-taken: No inventory of host {host} has arrived yet. Run the host inventory on the Coolify host.
codes.inventory_truncated: The inventory of host {host} was cut off, so it cannot prove that nothing is missing. Run the inventory again.
codes.inventory_rejected-lines: {count} lines of the inventory of host {host} were not understood and were dropped.
codes.inventory_unlisted-db: Host {host} runs a {engine} database container, {container} ({image}, {state}), that this run's plan does not list. Its data would be left behind. Map it, exclude it, or choose what to do with unlisted databases.
codes.inventory_unlisted-db-skipped: {container} on host {host} is a database the plan does not list. You chose to skip it, so it will not be migrated.
codes.inventory_unlisted-db-carry: {container} on host {host} is a database the plan does not list. You chose to carry it; check that it appears in the coverage ledger.
codes.inventory_unlisted-db-excluded: {container} on host {host} is not migrated: an operator excluded it.
codes.inventory_unlisted-db-mapped: {container} on host {host} was mapped to {item} by an operator.
codes.inventory_orphan-volume: Volume {volume} on host {host} is mounted by no container. Decide whether its data matters; skipping it lets the run continue.
codes.inventory_orphan-volume-skipped: Volume {volume} on host {host} is mounted by no container and will not be migrated (skipped).
codes.inventory_orphan-volume-excluded: Volume {volume} on host {host} is not migrated: an operator excluded it.
codes.inventory_size-unknown: {count} paths on host {host} could not be measured, so their size is unknown (not zero): {first}.
codes.inventory_reach-ok: Host {host} reaches this hub, and an upload of {acceptedMiB} MiB passes (part size {partMiB} MiB).
codes.inventory_reach-failed: Host {host} cannot reach this hub (HTTP {httpCode}), so the migrator cannot work from there.
codes.inventory_reach-unknown: Whether host {host} can reach this hub has not been measured yet.
codes.inventory_part-size-exceeds-cap: The path from host {host} to this hub accepts uploads of {acceptedMiB} MiB, less than the part size of {partMiB} MiB (a proxy in front of the hub caps request bodies). Set MIGRATION_VX_PART_MIB to {recommendMiB} (0 means even 32 MiB fails) or remove the cap, then run the inventory again.

version.title: Source version
version.supportedHint: The source runs a version this run was tested against.
version.newerHint: The source is newer than the newest version this run was tested with. The preflight warns, and you can accept it there.
version.too-oldHint: The source is older than the oldest supported version, so the preflight blocks the run.
version.unknownHint: The source did not report a version the hub could read. Run the preflight again to refresh it.
version.uncheckedHint: This source kind has no tested version range, so the hub does not judge the version.

runnerName.operator: You run the migrator on each source host
runnerName.agent: The Tugra agent on the source host
runnerName.coolify-host-loop: One script on the Coolify host, looping over the source hosts

placement.title: Placement
placement.desc: Which Tugra server each source host lands on. A source host that is not listed stops the run instead of landing on the default server.

safety.title: Held workers and image pins
safety.desc: Facts only someone who can see the source host knows: which apps are job runners that must stay stopped until after the cutover, and which image digest the source really runs. The hub cannot check them, so they are recorded as attested by you.
safety.closed: This run can no longer take these facts: it is finished or past the point of no return.
safety.marksHint: An app with no domain is held stopped until after the cutover. Mark an app that has no domain as a job runner when the plan cannot tell it is one, for example an app other apps reach through a container alias. Mark an app as a web app so it starts dark even without a domain. A job-runner mark on an app that serves a domain is refused: preflight fails until you remove the mark. Preflight also fails on a mark that matches no app of the plan, so check the spelling.
safety.itemInvalid: Use the plan item as it appears in the plan, starting with app:.
safety.roleJobRunner: Job runner (no domain): held until after the cutover
safety.pinsHint: An image with a floating tag such as latest is pinned to the digest you record here, so Tugra runs what the source runs. Take the digest from docker image inspect on the source host.
safety.image: Image as the plan shows it
safety.imageInvalid: Use the image reference without spaces.
safety.scopeHint: Leave empty when every source host runs the same digest.
safety.digestInvalid: A digest is sha256: followed by 64 lower-case hex characters.
safety.evidenceOperator: I read it on the host
